# Pull Request Checklist

## Code

- [ ] Feature implemented
- [ ] Solution builds
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Tests pass
- [ ] Sensitive data is protected
- [ ] No real secrets committed
- [ ] Audit logging added where needed

## Documentation

- [ ] User help article updated
- [ ] Admin guide updated
- [ ] Support troubleshooting guide updated
- [ ] Technical note updated
- [ ] Release note updated
- [ ] New permissions documented
- [ ] New settings documented
- [ ] New error messages documented
- [ ] Payroll/tax/ACH/security cautions documented
